price.label: Price
price.help: Latest price published by the source, converted into the currency you selected. This is not an execution price: depending on the venue and the moment, a real order would fill at a nearby but different level.

marketCap.label: Market cap
marketCap.help: Total value of the circulating supply at the current price. It is the most common size measure, but it ignores tokens not yet issued — see fully diluted valuation.

volume24h.label: Volume 24h
volume24h.help: Total amount traded over the last 24 hours across every venue. Thin volume makes the price far more sensitive to a single order.

fdv.label: Fully diluted valuation
fdv.help: Market cap the asset would reach if its entire maximum supply were circulating. Taken from the source as published, never recomputed: the rules on locked or burned tokens are theirs.

tvl.label: Total value locked
tvl.help: Amount deposited in the protocol's contracts. Exists only for decentralised finance, and measures usage rather than price.

rank.label: Rank
rank.help: Position by market cap within its asset class, as published by the source.

exchange.label: Listing venue
exchange.help: Market from which the source takes this asset's reference price.

high24h.label: 24h high
high24h.help: Highest price reached over the last 24 hours.

low24h.label: 24h low
low24h.help: Lowest price reached over the last 24 hours.

ath.label: All-time high
ath.help: Highest price ever reached. The percentage shows how far the current price sits below that record.

athWindow.label: 52-week high
athWindow.help: Highest price of the past year. The source does not publish an all-time record for this asset class.

atl.label: All-time low
atl.help: Lowest price ever reached. The percentage shows the gain since that floor.

atlWindow.label: 52-week low
atlWindow.help: Lowest price of the past year. The source does not publish an all-time floor for this asset class.

circulatingSupply.label: Circulating supply
circulatingSupply.help: Units actually in circulation, excluding locked, reserved or destroyed tokens.

totalSupply.label: Total supply
totalSupply.help: Units created to date, including locked tokens, net of those that have been burned.

maxSupply.label: Max supply
maxSupply.help: Ceiling of units the protocol will ever allow. Absent when no cap is written into the protocol.

issuedShare.label: Supply issued
issuedShare.help: Share of the maximum supply already circulating. Derived from two figures the source publishes, never estimated.

change1h.label: 1 hour
change1h.help: Price change over the last hour. The noisiest window: on a thinly traded asset it often reflects a single order rather than a real move.

change24h.label: 24 hours
change24h.help: Price change over the last 24 hours, as published by the source. This is the reference window for rankings.

change7d.label: 7 days
change7d.help: Price change over the past week.

change14d.label: 14 days
change14d.help: Price change over the past two weeks.

change30d.label: 30 days
change30d.help: Price change over the past month.

change1y.label: 1 year
change1y.help: Price change over the past year. A missing period means the source does not publish it — never that it is zero.

metricPage.noSeriesBody: The source publishes only a point-in-time value for this metric, with no time series. No chart is shown: drawing a curve would mean inventing the missing points.

chartCard.noData: Series not published by the source for this period.
